author: N6rL
content:
## Result

**ContentType::Annotation** added to raw_document.rs. Note explains Python frontier (alcanzai_ingestion) must be updated when M2 builds the Python-side ContentType enum.

**write_relationship()** added to SqliteLibrary as a pub inherent method. Inserts into the relationships table with a fresh UUID PK, subject_id, predicate, object_id, object_value, created_at.

**Annotation rendering** in vault_projection.rs: if content_type == Annotation, adds 'Annotates: [[canonical_id]]' wikilink line after the byline. target ID stored in provenance.canonical_id at ingest time.

**alcanzai annotate** subcommand in src/bin/alcanzai.rs:
- alcanzai annotate --library <db> --object <KnowledgeObjectId> <text>
- SHA-256 of annotation text as content_hash (sha2 = 0.10 dep added)
- std-only ISO 8601 timestamp (Rata Die calendar algorithm — no chrono dep)
- Verifies target KO exists before ingesting
- Writes annotation_of relationship row after ingest
- Prints annotation_id on stdout; alcanzai annotate --help exits 0 ✓

**sha2 = 0.10** added to [dependencies] in Cargo.toml.

**annotation_survives_delete_and_rebuild** integration test in tests/vault_rebuild_integration.rs: seeds 1 KO → ingests annotation KO via ingest_doc + write_relationship → rebuild → collect (2 notes) → rm -rf vault → rebuild → collect → assert_eq. Also asserts annotation note contains 'Annotates: [[target_id]]' wikilink. §9.4 PROVEN.

All checks: cargo fmt ✓ cargo clippy -D warnings ✓ (zero warnings) cargo test ✓
Total: 37 tests (22 unit + 11 membrane + 4 integration).
